items.title: Jerry Coker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 18, 2023
items.q: Junie Ferrell for example. I studied with him for quite some time.

ctx.x: Now when you went to college did you go as a — to study music because there was no jazz to be studied, but did you go then as a classical musician?

Well I was prepared to be a classical musician if necessary. And the courses, well for one thing I had private teachers who taught jazz that were good players. Junie Ferrell for example. I studied with him for quite some time. And it was a tremendous help. You know it kept me on track.

The Woody Herman Orchestra, I almost feel like I missed my era because I always had fantasies of playing in the swing bands, which you did. What did you have to do to get into the Woody Herman Orchestra? Did you have to audition? Did you have to audition?
